crew.overview: Bestowed with superhuman strength, a young mortal named Hercules sets out to prove himself a hero in the eyes of his father, the great god Zeus. Along with his friends Pegasus, a flying horse, and Phil, a personal trainer, Hercules is tricked by the hilarious, hotheaded villain Hades, who's plotting to take over Mount Olympus!
crew.title: Hercules

details.biography: Richard Jeffery started his career in traditional animation working on Walt Disney and Warner Bros. television series. Jeffery then moved to London and continued to work in some of the most prominent advertising-based studios, where he also continued his studies. Eventually he moved into television series work again in the 2D digital realm, where he quickly rose through the ranks to lead animator, designer, and then series director.
details.name: Richard Jeffery
